As well as its strong experience and reputation within the Livery arena, Company of Cooks stood out in the competitive tender for its commitment to sustainability and community. This includes the London Larder, which puts local artisan suppliers at the heart of the menu, and its partnership with Luminary Bakery, the social enterprise that supports and empowers London’s most disadvantaged women to thrive through skills development and meaningful employment.
